title: Expedition: logbooks and Grand Expeditions
summary: 0.5.5 made Expedition a core mechanic: run Expedition tablets for logbooks and rare runic monsters, then open Grand Expeditions, which The Quest Continues pushes to up to 3 modifiers.

budget.build_needs: Kills rare runic monsters and ice-encased bosses unearthed together by one explosive chain.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Runic Monsters drop logbooks; 'of Knowledge', Sown Seeds and Logbook Chance raise it.
Monsters from Verisium Remnants drop Verisium; the 'of Verisium' tablet mod raises it.
Listed among Expedition items; starts a Runic Remnant encounter.

nodes.name: Scarred Lands
nodes.effect: 20% increased number of Rare Expedition Monsters; 15% increased number of Runic Monster Markers

nodes.name: Ancient Inscriptions
nodes.effect: 8% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets for each type of Tablet affecting Map area

claim.note: Scarred Lands is Hilda's Expedition node (poe2db); pairing it with Ancient Inscriptions is our synthesis. Not measured.

steps: Allocate The Quest Continues and Sown Seeds, then Logbook Chance and Gaining Traction.
Set Hilda: Scarred Lands and Ancient Inscriptions.
Slot Expedition Tablets (0.5.5: 1 adds an Expedition; 2 add a Verisium Remnant and 35% density; 3 another Expedition; 4 another Remnant and density).
Chain explosives through Remnants before the rares; run logbooks as Grand Expeditions.
risks: Expedition Tablets cannot be obtained in the Runes of Aldur league (0.5.5 patch notes) — Forbidden Rites and Standard only.
Remnant modifiers also make the unearthed monsters harder.
